title: GSL-KR Continuous Epistemic Assimilation & Consolidation (KR-CEA) v1.0
purpose: Make continuous runtime learning, multi-agent knowledge accumulation, loss-aware distillation, model-consolidation candidacy and knowledge-dividend accounting explicit while preserving a categorical boundary between epistemic improvement and authority/constitutional change.
core_principle: runtime cognition != persistent knowledge != model/scaffold consolidation != authority != constitutional change
existing_owner_reuse: DesignEpoch where design semantics actually change

proposed_artifacts.name: KnowledgeCompressionReceipt
proposed_artifacts.boundary: Loss-aware compression should normally emit/reuse HistoricalSemanticSummary or other existing knowledge artifacts rather than create a competing summary owner.

proposed_artifacts.name: CrossContextPatternReceipt
proposed_artifacts.boundary: Cross-context inference requires explicit lawful/privacy authority to perform the join and does not imply universal raw-data visibility.

proposed_artifacts.name: ModelConsolidationCandidate
proposed_artifacts.boundary: Acceptance does not mutate deployed model weights or privileged scaffolding.

candidate_invariants: KR-CEA-002 Runtime Learning Without Weight Mutation
KR-CEA-011 Retrieval Beats Rediscovery Where Valid
KR-CEA-012 Model Upgrade Is Separately Governed
candidate_tests: TEST-KR-CEA-001 verified novel fact becomes retrievable without weight update
TEST-KR-CEA-002 unsupported repetition does not become Knowledge by multiplicity
TEST-KR-CEA-003 contradictory accepted evidence updates BeliefTimeline and revalidates dependents
TEST-KR-CEA-004 authorized cross-context pattern correlation succeeds
TEST-KR-CEA-005 forbidden cross-context join remains inaccessible
TEST-KR-CEA-006 lossy compression cannot claim complete reconstruction
TEST-KR-CEA-007 high-confidence scientific discovery cannot alter constitutional authority
TEST-KR-CEA-008 validated discovery is reused without needless rediscovery when independence is not required
TEST-KR-CEA-009 synthetic repetition with common ancestry is not independent corroboration
TEST-KR-CEA-010 ModelConsolidationCandidate cannot mutate deployed weights without separate evolution path
TEST-KR-CEA-011 100000 synthetic reports derived from one unsupported source do not increase independent-evidence count
TEST-KR-CEA-012 stale or scope-mismatched retrieved knowledge cannot substitute for current applicable knowledge

knowledge_dividend_measurement.concept: validated future cognition avoided or improved / cost of producing + validating + maintaining the knowledge

do_nothing: v15.5 already contains knowledge persistence, historical summaries, belief transitions, continuous failure learning and dependency-aware revalidation, but it does not yet make the full immediate runtime-cognition -> governed reusable knowledge -> separately governed model-consolidation pipeline and knowledge-dividend accounting explicit enough to prevent repeated rediscovery or accidental coupling of knowledge promotion with authority.
required_review_before_admission: GSL-COMPARE against complete v15.5 ownership/reference closure
>=3 independent qualified reviewer families on the same bounded KR target, preferably 4+
no duplicate artifacts where existing owners are adequate
promotion_boundary: This file is tracking only. It does not ratify KR-CEA, edit v15.5, create authority, change constitutional semantics, or promote Garden v15.6.
